definitions.explanation: The total set of questions on a test, quiz, or exam. Most commonly used in {全問|ぜんもん}{正解|せいかい} (all correct) and similar collocations.

examples.japanese: {全問|ぜんもん}⟦{正解|せいかい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧だった。
examples.english: I got all the questions right.

examples.japanese: {全問|ぜんもん}⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一時間|いちじかん}→一時間：00941_ichijikan⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It took me an hour to solve all the questions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しくて→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧、{全問|ぜんもん}⟦{答|こた}えられた→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いなかった→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This test was hard, and not a single student was able to answer every question.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{全|ぜん}→全〜：28337_zen⟧ (all) + ⟦{問|もん}→〜問：04016_mon⟧ (question/problem, used as a counter). Almost always used in school and test contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全問|ぜんもん}⟦{正解|せいかい}→正解：03083_seikai⟧: all answers correct; perfect score
- {全問|ぜんもん}⟦{不正解|ふせいかい}→不正解：18929_fuseikai⟧: all answers wrong
- {全問|ぜんもん}⟦{解答|かいとう}→解答：00447_kaitou⟧: answering every question
- {全問|ぜんもん}{必答|ひっとう}: all questions must be answered

RELATED WORDS:
- {一問|いちもん}: one question
- ⟦{設問|せつもん}→設問：22077_setsumon⟧: a (test) question
- ⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧: perfect score
